orders = await orders_get_orders()
from collections import Counter
ids = [o["order_id"] for o in orders]
return {
  "n": len(orders),
  "unique_ids": len(set(ids)),
  "regions": sorted(Counter(repr(o["region"]) for o in orders).items()),
  "statuses": sorted(Counter(repr(o["status"]) for o in orders).items()),
  "amount_types": sorted(Counter(type(o["amount"]).__name__ for o in orders).items()),
  "bad_amounts": [o["amount"] for o in orders if not isinstance(o["amount"], (int, float))][:10],
}
